name: studclub-monorepo
description: StuddClub VIP - Dynamic Full Stack (Frontend + Admin + Backend API + MongoDB)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,ADMIN,FRONTEND" -c "blue,magenta,cyan" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,ADMIN,FRONTEND" -c "blue,magenta,cyan" "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:admin" "npm run start:frontend"
scripts.build:all: cd studclub-admin && npm run build && cd ../studclub-main && npm run build
